ShortDescription.Value: [Beta] Automatically creates city-wide bus transit networks: places roadside stops with smart spacing, generates multi-stop loop lines, and connects them to your depots.

Publish.LongDescription:
### [Beta Release] Auto Bus Lines is currently in open beta! Feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are warmly welcome.
Auto Bus Lines automatically plans and builds complete, functional bus transit networks across your entire city with a single click.
Every neighborhood is given passenger bus service: roadside bus stops are automatically placed along road spans away from intersection conflict zones, connected into smooth, balanced transit loops, and routed directly to your nearest bus depots and passenger terminals.
### Features - **City-Wide Automated Coverage**: Scans all paved road networks and places roadside bus stops ensuring complete coverage across residential, commercial, and industrial districts. - **Smart Curb & Span Placement**: Bus stops are placed at safe mid-span road positions with safe clearance from intersections and junctions. Full support for right-hand and left-hand traffic, divided roads, and one-way streets. - **Depot & Terminal Connectivity**: Routes automatically originate from and link to your nearest Bus Depots and Bus Terminals without requiring manual district assignments. - **Existing Stop & Platform Reuse**: Discovers and integrates existing bus stops and passenger station platforms into newly generated lines. - **Loop Optimization**: Multi-corridor tour planner with 2-Opt path smoothing generates efficient, circular bus lines that keep transit running without vehicle congestion. - **Built-in Route Repair**: Includes an in-game "Repair Broken Bus Lines" tool that scans your bus lines for pathfinding issues (such as road modifications or bulldozed connections), nudges problematic stops, and re-triggers pathfinding. - **In-Game Configuration**: Full options panel under Options > Mod Settings to configure minimum/maximum stops per line, maximum route length, stop spacing, preferred bus stop model (including custom/modded stops), and auto-generation on save load.
### How to Use 1. Build at least one **Bus Depot** or **Passenger Bus Terminal** in your city. 2. Open **Options > Mod Settings > Auto Bus Lines**. 3. Click **"Generate Bus Lines Now"** (or keep "Auto Generate On Load" enabled to generate on load). 4. Watch your city's public transit spring to life! If you modify your road network later, click **"Repair Broken Bus Lines"** anytime.

ChangeLog.Value: Beta release: Automated bus stop placement, depot-connected route generation, 2-Opt smoothed transit loops, in-game configuration menu, and route repair tool.
